*** 1 INJ *** Report of a minor injury as a motorist was caught in the tornado crossing Jefferson County earlier. Time and location approximate.

*** 1 INJ *** Tornado continued into southwest Jefferson County from Chambers County. It snapped off power poles at French Rd before continuing northeast. An area of trees were snapped off and uprooted just south of the Big Hill Strategic Oil Reserve. Tornado continued northeast where it destroyed the top floor of the Sabine Ranch Lodge, stripped metal from a nearby industrial building, flipped a car into a side yard, and damaged the roofs of two homes. The car contained two people, one sustained a minor injury. The tornado crossed Hwys 87 and 82 where it snapped transmission poles. Finally, it moved overtop Sabine Lake. Tornado damage became apparent near the intersection of 17th Street and Savannah Ave southeast of Motiva. The tornado path traveled east, peaking out near the Progressive Missionary Baptist Church where a large portion of the masonry walls collapsed. Another home near 11th Street and Orange Ave had the roof completely removed and some walls collapsed. Numerous homes sustained roof damage along the path along many trees downed or damaged. The path continued across Rose Hill Park and onto Pleasure Island. The tornado may have continued into Sabine Lake. The tornado lasted for roughly 4 minutes with peak winds estimated near 120 mph, making it an EF2.
